# Mermaid, vendored

`mermaid.min.js.gz` is `dist/mermaid.min.js` of the npm package `mermaid` **12.3.0**, compressed
with `gzip -9 -n`. okbot serves it at `/apps/sdk/mermaid.min.js` to the artifact viewer, which
renders `mermaid` artifacts with `securityLevel: "strict"` (ADR 0021).
